assets.prompt:
STRUCTURE A — LIVING CANVAS. Replace fixed columns with one expansive asymmetric preview canvas and a horizontal instrument shelf; it is a creative but calm cursor design tool. Top slim caption and Pointer wordmark left; a small floating navigation capsule below caption at upper left with 外观 selected, 动效, 测试, 设置. Top right near caption a steady compact text 有未应用的修改 and blue 应用更改 button. Keep caption controls separate.
Main canvas is NOT a boxed pair of cards: one broad open comparison field across the middle, pearl on left about 62%, graphite on right 38%, clean vertical draggable divider with a small tactile double-arrow grab handle halfway. The right dark field reaches toward right edge with gently rounded outer corners; the left field merges naturally with window content. One large dominant canonical black cursor in the left field, one medium white cursor in right field. Labels 浅色背景 and 深色背景 sit quietly near top. Discreet 草稿预览 text near center top; small 32 px actual-size specimen close to selected large cursor. A small role tool capsule 箭头 selected / 手形 / 输入 / 加载 hovers at center lower edge of stage.
Lower quarter is a single beautifully crafted compact floating horizontal instrument shelf, NOT another navigation bar or a card grid. Left zone 4 flat shape specimens 圆润 selected / 精准 / 锐角 / 像素, center 大小 slider 32 px, right 背景适配 自动 and 配色 black/white swatches with 更多 button. Tool shelf is inset, gracefully asymmetrical in width, with left specimen section occupying more space and tight grouped controls. Main cursor stage remains visually dominant. A tiny hint 拖动分界查看深浅效果 supports real interaction. There is no sidebar or vertical inspector. Novel confident spacing and placement, luxurious material restraint, no glowing cursor.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE exceptional high fidelity Windows desktop cursor-utility interface, edge-to-edge front-on landscape 1536 x 1024. UI surface only, no device, desk, browser, infographic or marketing poster.
Inputs: reference image 1 is ONLY a MATERIAL / TYPE / ICON / COLOR reference from the previous Pointer proposal; retain its luxurious neutral Apple system / Liquid Glass finish but DO NOT preserve its three-column layout, sidebar, tall inspector, boxed comparison panel, or footer. Reference image 2 is ONLY the canonical Pointer arrow contour and flat black/white rendering; never copy its split page layout.
Committed world: pearl #F6F6F8, opaque white content, graphite #25262B for dark comparison, ink #202126, restrained deep #0064D8 interaction accents, exquisite optically aligned thin-line icons, readable refined Chinese typography, translucent functional tool islands with luminous edge and soft directional shadow, concentric radii, substantial deliberate whitespace. Materials serve interaction; no glass nested in glass. Typography, palette, material quality coherent with reference 1.
The Pointer arrow shape is a broad rounded three-point arrow exactly like reference 2, not a generic long-tailed Windows cursor. Light background = BLACK body WHITE outline. Dark background = WHITE body BLACK outline. All glyphs are flat 2D, NO shadow, glow, halo, 3D extrusion or change of contour. Cursor family includes arrow, hand, I-beam, loading ring and resize. Main page edits GLOBAL cursor appearance and previews the draft, not unimplemented per-role custom settings. Real choices: shape 圆润 selected, 精准, 锐角, 像素; size 32 px; adaptation 自动; black/white color. Retain short accessible labeled controls, visible selected state and one primary 应用更改 action. Navigation always has four items 外观, 动效, 测试, 设置. Draft is labelled 草稿预览; pixel dimensions are illustrative, not a literal screenshot calibration.
Express a living creative layout through asymmetry, scale hierarchy, content relationships, and thoughtful interactive anchors. NO fake performance stats, no decorative orbital lines, no automatic motion arrows, no Apple logo, no macOS traffic lights, no grid framework of generic settings cards. Native Windows minus / square / close in top right. This must look clearly like a usable actual application, every tool has a task, all text and UI inside viewport.
assets.targetedEditPrompt: Edit this Pointer interface with a precise small batch of corrections. Preserve its current materials, colors, geometry, asymmetric stage, navigation, controls, preview cursors and caption. The large black cursor is an enlarged specimen: beneath it replace the misleading 32 × 32 / 实际大小 label with 示例 32 px / 放大预览. Do not label the huge glyph as actual size. Add one compact subtle frosted role selector capsule inside the stage, horizontally centered about 65 pixels ABOVE the existing divider-drag hint and above the bottom instrument shelf: 箭头 selected / 手形 / 输入 / 加载 with thin icons. Keep it small, readable, not overlapping the cursor specimens or their labels; it can straddle the comparison divider. The role selector controls preview only. No other layout or styling changes, no cursor glow.

assets.prompt:
STRUCTURE B — CURSOR FAMILY. A specimen-led spatial workspace with one clearly dominant selected role and small related roles in a shallow ordered fan. Avoid an orbit, ornamental ring or cards. Top left Pointer wordmark; title 光标家族 below, short sublabel 统一风格，预览每一种角色. Top center compact floating nav 外观 selected / 动效 / 测试 / 设置. Top right steady small 草稿 and blue 应用更改 action, separate Windows caption controls.
Middle approximately 55% of viewport is an airy pearl canvas with a huge flat canonical rounded arrow as focal point just LEFT of center. Along a gentle shallow fan beneath and around it, distribute smaller accurate flat hand, I-beam, loading ring and resize glyphs with short readable labels 手形, 输入, 加载, 调整. Selected 箭头 label is near the dominant arrow with a thin blue check/pill. Hierarchy not equal size, no clutter, no lines between glyphs. In upper right of this stage a small graphite comparison window holds a white-body black-outline version of selected canonical arrow labelled 深色背景; no fake 3D stage.
Bottom has two related functional regions, not fixed three columns: a compact glass contextual tool island toward bottom right headed 箭头预览 with 浅色 / 深色 / 对比, 实际大小 32 px, a 配色 disclosure and 更多选项. Toward lower left a broad horizontal shape-selection strip with four specimens 圆润 selected, 精准, 锐角, 像素 and a small global size slider 32 px beneath. A tiny 全球 shared-setting label should read 统一外观 (not English or invented functionality). Selecting role only chooses preview; shapes and size apply to whole theme. Balance dominant arrow, smaller family roles, understated tools. Alive through focal relationships and surprising but understandable spatial composition. No tall sidebar, no full-height inspector, no generic equal card rows.

STRUCTURE C — SCENE ATELIER. A context-rich asymmetric cursor workshop built from real interactive content; not a sterile pair of specimens and not a dashboard. Top left Pointer wordmark and title 光标外观. Under title small 草稿预览 — scene cursors preview a draft only. Top center compact floating nav 外观 selected / 动效 / 测试 / 设置. Top right steady 有未应用的修改 and blue 应用更改 action, separate Windows caption.
Main workspace occupies the upper two thirds, composition is visually asymmetric: LEFT about 64% is a large beautifully cropped alpine lake photograph inside a single softly rounded image-viewer content scene with a small floating zoom toolbar near its bottom, and a tasteful white-hand black-outline cursor visible over a dark forest area. RIGHT upper about 32% is a shorter pearl text-editing content scene labelled 文字输入, with only the sentence 在这里试试你的输入光标 and a visible black/white I-beam. RIGHT lower is a graphite click-content scene labelled 深色点击, one real button labelled 按住体验, and a flat white-body BLACK-outline canonical rounded arrow on its dark surface. The photo is purposeful image-drag preview content; it must NOT become wallpaper or a poster. The two right scenes have no status cards, metrics or nested decorative cards. Across the scenes precise white gutters and material clarity, real content leads attention.
BOTTOM about 24% has an elegant floating horizontal instrument shelf that is narrower than full viewport: four flat shape specimens 圆润 selected / 精准 / 锐角 / 像素, size slider 大小 32 px, 背景适配 自动, 配色 black/white swatches, 更多. A modest small scene selector just above shelf offers 场景预览 selected / 深浅对比; all global appearance controls remain findable. No sidebar, no tall inspector, no second primary action. This composition must be materially coherent with the two earlier layouts but much more lively through different content scales and photo/text/click relationships. Functional Apple-grade glass only for nav and tool shelves, stable opaque surfaces for content and text.

assets.targetedEditPrompt:
Edit this Pointer scene-workspace mockup with only these corrections. Preserve all layout, photograph, controls, typography, material finish, navigation and the two right-hand scenes. Replace ONLY the large white-outline black arrow over the dark forest in the photograph with a flat WHITE-FILLED hand/pan cursor with a thin BLACK outline, about 48 pixels tall, rounded Pointer-family style. This must clearly be a hand, with no shadow or glow, as the photo scene tests image dragging. Do not modify the arrow in the deep-gray click scene. Simplify the verbose tiny header explanation after 光标外观 to just 草稿预览. Everything else stays unchanged.
Reference image 2 contributes ONLY the exact existing Pointer hand silhouette, finger markings and black/white contrast. Match this silhouette rather than inventing a new hand. The reference's split page layout must not influence the application layout.

interactionState.prompt:
Create a second interaction-state image of this exact Pointer Cursor Family interface, preserving pixel layout, material, palette, text size, global control values, navigation, top apply button, caption, shape choices and all unrelated content. It illustrates selecting a preview ROLE, not changing the theme.
Change the selected focal role from arrow to HAND. At the current large arrow position, draw a large elegant rounded black-filled hand with a clean WHITE outline, visibly a hand/pan cursor with one leading finger and curved thumb/palm. A small blue selected check and label 手形 appear under it instead of 箭头. The old small hand role at lower-left becomes a small black-body white-outline canonical rounded ARROW labelled 箭头. Keep 输入, 加载, 调整 role specimens in their original positions. In the dark comparison upper-right, replace the white arrow with a WHITE-FILLED hand with BLACK outline of the same silhouette. Change contextual inspector heading 箭头预览 to 手形预览. All global style/size/palette controls remain identical; selecting role only chooses the preview. NO orbit lines, glow, duplicate selection, decorative changes or new features. This is an unimplemented interaction-state design mockup, not an animated working screenshot.
Reference image 2 contributes ONLY the exact existing Pointer hand silhouette, finger markings and black/white contrast. Match this silhouette rather than inventing a new hand. The reference's split page layout must not influence the application layout.
